title: NestJS API bootstrap, safe configuration, health, error model, and observability baseline

target_symbols.reason: HTTP bootstrap, global validation, request correlation, and graceful startup
typed environment validation and production-secret gate

acceptance: Nest API starts from apps/api/src/main.ts with global ValidationPipe and a safe JSON error envelope.
Every response has a request ID, preserving a valid inbound UUID or generating a new one; structured logs include it without secrets or request bodies.
GET /health/live proves process liveness without database access; GET /health/ready reports dependency readiness separately and is honest when dependencies are unavailable.
Runtime configuration rejects invalid ports and production startup without required secret material, while development needs no committed secret.
Focused behavioral tests demonstrate config, request ID, error mapping, and separate health behavior before implementation is accepted.
No database schema/migration, customer data, external provider, deployment, commit, or push is introduced.

commands: temporary API runtime smoke: GET /health/live and GET /health/ready
